name: Deborah Gair
reason: Re-read her own site (deborahgair.com, respecting its 60-second crawl delay) on 4 Nov 2026: much of her Quantum-Touch teaching is framed around physical health (Level 2 includes 'reversed aging' and digestive health for weight loss, Level 3 promises symptoms go away, a Renewal course on 'limiting your health', the Infinity Vortex sold as an 'Ageless technology', testimonials about pain and inflammation). Once those are left out, only about three items with their own URL remain (Level 1 workshop page, sessions page, Black Whole Healing page), with no usable videos (one 1-minute clip), no books, no free resources, no published email (contact form only) and no published base. Too thin and largely health-framed: borderline call. Her site does name The Shift Network (black-whole-healing and infinity-vortex pages), if the owner wants to revisit.
